body.name: \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{up}}\)
body.construction: Use the continuous integrated probability and signed marked contrasts on \(\mathcal C_*\), derive their nearly parametric forward radius, pass both compactly supported entire transforms through the quantitative analytic-continuation argument at order \(K_n\), recover the protected quotient \(q_x/f_x\) on \(I\), and take measurable extrema over the exact compact profile \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\).
